levels.surface: صالح بن إبراهيم بن عبد الرحمن بن عوف

notes: «عن أبيه، عن جده» : bare relations, so two relation links (rule 7); the story's first person «بينا أنا واقف» is the grandfather's own account, so he is the last link (rule 6)
The closing gloss «(عبد الرحمن بن عوف)» names the grandfather, but it is an editor's note outside the chain, so it is not written as the surface (rule 1)
«قال محمد سمع يوسف صالحا» is the compiler's note on the route, not a link
